FILES: rich/cells.py:10
ROOT CAUSE: The regex `_is_single_cell_widths` uses the range `\u0020-\u006f`, which only covers characters up to 'o'. This excludes many common single-width characters like 'p' through 'z', causing the "fast path" to be skipped for many standard strings and hurting performance.
CHANGE: Update the regex range `\u0020-\u006f` to `\u0020-\u007e` to include all printable ASCII characters.
TEST: tests/test_cells.py
